mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.parent_id, m.name, m.type, m.path, m.component, m.perms, m.icon, m.sort, m.visible, m.status, m.create_by, m.update_by, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.sort ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != '' AND m.type IN ('C', 'B')
